Hero.description: RealView Media was founded on a simple truth: if a picture is worth a thousand words, a fully immersive experience is worth a thousand visits.

Story.paragraph1: In a world saturated with heavily edited, static photos, consumers have lost trust. When your customers are deciding where to stay, eat, or shop, a standard 2D photo gallery leaves them guessing what lies just outside the frame.
Story.paragraph2: We saw this disconnect and decided to bridge the gap. By combining architectural-grade photography with immersive virtual reality technology, we eliminate the guesswork.
Story.paragraph3: We don't just take photos of your business. We engineer digital twins that put your customers halfway through your front door before they ever leave their house.

preparation.question: What should be prepared before photography?
preparation.answer: The space should be clean, staged and free of temporary clutter. We provide a preparation checklist and confirm any access restrictions before shoot day.

shootDuration.question: How long does the shoot take?
shootDuration.answer: Timing depends on the size, number of viewpoints and operating conditions. We estimate the required on-site time after reviewing the scope.

revisions.question: What is included in the review?
revisions.answer: The agreed production scope includes a review of navigation, labels and reasonable presentation adjustments. Reshoots or new areas are scoped separately.

ownership.question: Who owns the Google Business Profile?
ownership.answer: The client remains primary owner. RealView Media is invited as a manager only when profile work is included, so access can be reviewed or removed at any time.

embedding.question: Can the tour be used outside Google Maps?
embedding.answer: Yes. Depending on the selected deliverable, the tour can include a shareable link and website embed support.

timeline.question: What can affect the 10-business-day timeline?
timeline.answer: Delayed access, missing business information, late review feedback, reshoots or additions outside the agreed scope may change the schedule. Any exception is communicated clearly.

Research.title: The numbers tell the story.
Research.intro: Virtual tours help people understand a place before they visit. These findings describe consumer behavior around business listings, mapping products and immersive imagery.

interest.description: Listings with photos and a virtual tour are twice as likely to generate interest.

booking.description: People aged 18–34 are 130% more likely to book based on a virtual tour.

demand.description: People surveyed want more business listings to include virtual tours; only 7% said they were unnecessary.

visits.description: On average, 41% of place searches made with mapping products result in an on-site visit.

Research.source: Source: Google-commissioned Ipsos research on virtual tours and Google mapping-product research.

management.question: What is Google Ads Search management?
management.answer: It covers the planning, setup, monitoring, and ongoing optimization of campaigns that show text ads when people search for relevant services on Google.

spend.question: Is advertising spend included in the management fee?
spend.answer: No. Advertising spend is paid directly to Google and is separate from the RealView Media service fee unless another written agreement is made.

launch.question: How quickly can a campaign launch?
launch.answer: Timing depends on account access, campaign scope, tracking readiness, and Google's ad review. A launch schedule is confirmed after the initial review.

existingAccount.question: Can you work with an existing Google Ads account?
existingAccount.answer: Yes. Existing accounts can be reviewed before any changes are proposed, with recommendations based on the account structure, data, and business goals.

guarantees.question: Do you guarantee first position or a specific number of leads?
guarantees.answer: No. Auction conditions, competition, budgets, demand, websites, and many other factors affect results, so rankings, traffic, leads, conversions, and return cannot be guaranteed.

combined.question: Can Google Ads be combined with a 360° virtual-tour project?
combined.answer: Yes. Search campaigns can bring relevant visitors to your business, while strong visual content and virtual tours can help them understand the space and decide what to do next. No specific outcome is guaranteed.
